question: Are fixed prior-boundary response contrasts reproducible across actual source-qualified same-plate repeats?
coverage_scope: Same-compound-plate and finite-value subset only. Small same-plate coverage does not imply the library lacks prior top10 identities; full-menu policy utility was not evaluated.

next_evidence.constraints: New metadata/source/endpoint freeze; preserve plate/pool/QC dependencies. Constituent repeats do not independently validate their own collapsed endpoint; raw-isolation claims require raw controls/MFI.

later_scientific_gate: Qualified distinct evidence channel, justified useful-benefit margin and cost basis, fixed recruitment/menu and strong deterministic/batch controls before any dual-core or Agent superiority claim
